Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer's analysis incorrectly concluded that Icehouse was released in 1989 based on the visible text "Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set (1999)" on the BoardGameGeek page. The visible text explicitly shows the year 1999 next to the game title, yet the agent hallucinated or misread this as 1989. This error propagated through subsequent steps, leading to the wrong conclusion that Icehouse (1989) was released before Kill Doctor Lucky (1996). The correct earliest release for the Looney Labs Icehouse system (The Martian Chess Set) is 1999, which would still make it released before Kill Doctor Lucky (1996), but the specific year cited (1989) was factually incorrect based on the provided evidence in that step.
